fields.statement: Detached checkout at 289c5fa77, under the MemoryMax/TasksMax cap: go test -p 2 -trimpath ./internal/run -run 'TestSpawnedChildQuestion|TestConductorQuestion|TestSpawnResume' -count=1 -v exit 0 (TestSpawnedChildQuestionArbitrated included=false/true PASS); go test -p 2 -trimpath ./internal/run/... exit 0; go vet ./internal/run exit 0; rhiza ship generate exit 0 (0 files changed); rhiza render exit 0, tree clean. Diff read: pollAgent calls the new askChildren for step.Conducts() steps, which polls live spawns of the step via AgentStatus only, journals a block and reuses ask (AddQuestion, asked entry keyed on the child session, arbiter, Deliver to the child, answered entry, unblock) with no advisor or notice since arbitratesIn holds; non-question blocks are not journalled or arbitrated; reconcileSpawns untouched; a failed verdict ends the step with an error naming the question. The test asserts asked/arbiter/deliver/answered order, no StartAdvisor and no Notify in a non-autonomous run, the step finishing on the conductor's pass, the failing-verdict error detail, a spawn-ended child never polled, and a permission block not arbitrated. Only engine.go, engine_test.go and the leaf's .rhiza log/render changed; no TODOs.
